prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Louis MO for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and how much you value rate versus service. **For a St. Louis buyer who wants a local starting point, I’d compare Midwest BankCentre and Better Rate Mortgage.**

- **Midwest BankCentre** has a local mortgage team and strong review scores in the results: 4.89/5 on Experience.com and 4.97/5 on Zillow. [Mortgage page](https://www.midwestbankcentre.com/mortgage/)
- **Better Rate Mortgage** is a local broker with a St. Louis office and many positive customer reviews, including comments about responsiveness and help with purchase loans. [Website](https://betterratemortgage.com/)

Also get a quote from a credit union you’re eligible to join—such as **Neighbors Credit Union**—since local credit unions may be competitive. Rates change frequently, and advertised rates may assume specific credit, down-payment, and points.

**Best next step:** Ask at least three lenders for written Loan Estimates on the same day, using the same loan amount, down payment, and rate-lock period. Compare the **APR, lender fees, points, and cash to close**, not just the advertised interest rate. If you share your approximate credit score, down payment, and whether you’re considering conventional, FHA, or VA financing, I can help narrow the shortlist.
